note: The parser helper carries the input buffer length and the fixed 64-entry header_start array into parse_http_request.
After a valid request line, the remaining input-controlled header block is passed to parse_headers.
The input-controlled total request length determines how many CRLF-terminated header lines the loop can find.
Each CR byte in the crafted header block is discovered as the end of another header line.
On the 33rd header, n_headers is already 64, so this writes an 8-byte pointer one element past the 64-entry global header_start array.
The bounds check is performed only after two header_start writes, so the required condition that n_headers stay below N_HEADER_START before indexing was not enforced.
